second_order: rallying NM helpers and keeping them plugging away
theme_note: These passages recruit and sustain shared pixel work: the practice ranges from seeking NM recognition and waking more people up to restarting, staying twenty hours, pledging a night, thanking helpers, and joining again after losses.

second_order: drawing a workable zia and dividing up the pixels
theme_note: These passages turn a symbol into coordinated work: participants invite suggestions, choose dimensions and images, compare designs, direct others to the plan, divide replacing from filling, and settle on a simpler design before expansion.

second_order: checking who is placing which colour
theme_note: These turns monitor the live work itself: they name yellow, inspect apparent authorship, promise the intended colour, and flag that a glitch makes coordination harder.

second_order: shifting the zia to a spot that might hold
theme_note: These passages search for viable ground and move when a location is active or contested: options range from existing yellow shapes and rival logos to a new coordinate, an upward shift, or a simpler mark elsewhere.

second_order: working out overlaps with other builders
theme_note: These passages handle competing claims in words: participants anticipate retaliation, warn about strong neighbours, explain why work looked abandoned, threaten and accept agreements, ask for compromise or help, and dispute who can maintain a location. The positions vary from joking caution and justification to explicit truce-making and continued rivalry.

second_order: reaching outside the thread for help and talk
theme_note: These passages deliberately connect the local thread to other groups or a dedicated organizing subreddit: asking r/americanflaginplace for help differs from sending ongoing talk and newly arriving helpers to r/ziaplace.

second_order: filling an NM heart alongside the zia
theme_note: These passages maintain a second New Mexico mark by asking for yellow fill, supplying its direct coordinates, and repeating the request in a separate titled post.

second_order: moving Zia-building onto the new canvas
theme_note: These post-event passages carry the practice to pxls.space: one posts the replacement coordinates and another returns with a Zia image and call for help. This differs from shifting within r/place because the venue itself has changed after placement ended.

second_order: celebrating what made the final canvas
theme_note: The surviving title celebrates seeing the linked work on the final r/place canvas; the image itself is not available as textual evidence.

second_order: questioning why canvas-building is a trend
theme_note: This lone contrary turn questions the activity rather than joining, planning, moving, or negotiating it, so it remains a single-code theme.
